claims.harm: Toggling external_signer flag on an existing wallet leaves descriptor ScriptPubKeyMans out of sync, causing wallet operations like display address and send to fail until reloaded.
claims.quote: The SPKM subclass is chosen when it's constructed, and toggling doesn't rebuild the existing ones, so after unloadwallet/loadwallet, with nothing else changed, both work.
claims.settled_by_quote: it's actually easier to just have the RPC automatically reload the whole wallet for this flag. So I went with that.

claims.harm: Setting external_signer flag on a build without external signer support bricks the wallet from loading on that binary.
claims.quote: On a build with -DENABLE_EXTERNAL_SIGNER=OFF I set the flag on an ordinary wallet and it no longer loads on that binary, not even after a restart

claims.harm: In an external signer wallet with private keys enabled, FillPSBT attempts to sign hot key UTXOs using the hardware signer and fails.
claims.quote: a descriptor holding a hot key also gets an ExternalSignerScriptPubKeyMan here, and at LoadDescriptorScriptPubKeyMan. Its FillPSBT() goes straight to the device when sign=true and never falls back.
claims.settled_by_quote: Confirmed fixed on a Ledger Flex, thanks.
